tasks.objective: Write reports/entrypoints.md using only package.json. Report the name and version, and the exact scripts.start and scripts.desktop:start commands. Keep all input files unchanged. Use tools to create the report; Codex owns final acceptance.
tasks.validation: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const s=fs.readFileSync('reports/entrypoints.md','utf8'); for(const v of [p.name,p.version,p.scripts.start,p.scripts['desktop:start']]) if(!s.includes(v)) process.exit(1)"

tasks.objective: Write reports/checks.md using only package.json. Report the exact scripts.test and scripts.verify commands, and scripts.package:desktop:windows. Keep package.json unchanged. Act only as a bounded implementation worker; Codex owns final acceptance.
tasks.validation: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const s=fs.readFileSync('reports/checks.md','utf8'); for(const k of ['test','verify','package:desktop:windows']) if(!s.includes(p.scripts[k])) process.exit(1)"
